g.text: Frontend: incident command center and admin dashboard (as implemented)
«container» / «component» containers own the view state and
pass data down to presentational panels.
«hook» useSimulation is the client-side store: the live session,
the playback loop (REST polling, no WebSocket) and every command;
«Facade» api hides fetch, the /api base URL and error handling
«Adapter» SceneView bridges declarative React and the imperative
